note: v5 'The Handover'. Single source of truth for narration and pacing. `text` is the caption; optional `say` is what the narrator voice reads. Times are seconds: leadIn = picture before the first line, tail = picture after the last line, gap = pause before a line. Every figure comes from src/film/data.ts (Talent Command Center, as of 30 Sep 2026).

lines.text: There are 309 roles in this company that can never be empty.
lines.say: There are three hundred and nine roles in this company that can never be empty.

lines.text: Not for a week. Not for a night.
Each one keeps this plant safe, running and performing.
Talent Management at OQ RPI exists to answer three questions the business cannot afford to get wrong.
Which roles matter most? Who is ready to take them? And what must we build before we need it?
It starts with an honest conversation: 680 performance reviews this year.
lines.say: It starts with an honest conversation: six hundred and eighty performance reviews this year.

lines.text: Then, once a year, our leaders sit in one room and decide who will lead us next.
Today, 43 are ready to step up.
lines.say: Today, forty-three are ready to step up.

lines.text: Then we build them.
237 leaders through MASAR since 2023. 24 more in ROBBAN this October, with the Center for Creative Leadership.
lines.say: Two hundred and thirty-seven leaders through MASAR since twenty twenty-three. Twenty-four more in ROBBAN this October, with the Center for Creative Leadership.

lines.text: And secondments across OQ and national institutions bring new capability home.
And we plan every handover.
132 of our 309 critical roles already have a named successor. Named is not the same as ready: readiness is confirmed in the Talent Review.
lines.say: One hundred and thirty-two of our three hundred and nine critical roles already have a named successor. Named is not the same as ready: readiness is confirmed in the Talent Review.

lines.text: By 2030, 242 roles held today by international experts are planned to be led by Omanis, with each expert staying on as a mentor.
lines.say: By twenty thirty, two hundred and forty-two roles held today by international experts are planned to be led by Omanis, with each expert staying on as a mentor.

lines.text: 99 Omani successors are already named.
lines.say: Ninety-nine Omani successors are already named.

lines.text: When people go above and beyond, we notice: 1,369 recognitions in eight months.
lines.say: When people go above and beyond, we notice. One thousand, three hundred and sixty-nine recognitions in eight months.

lines.text: All of it lives in one place, the Talent Command Center, live for every leader.
Ask it a question, in English or in Arabic, and it answers.
This is the capability OQ RPI is building.
Continuity for the roles that matter most. Leaders ready before they are needed. And Omani talent at the heart of the business.
The remaining 177 critical roles are the work ahead.
lines.say: The remaining one hundred and seventy-seven critical roles are the work ahead.

lines.text: The future is not built by systems.
It is built by people.
OQ RPI Talent Management. Building tomorrow's talent, together.
